select c.customer_id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.credit_status, p.dealer_level, p.auth_regions, ifnull(o.order_count, 0) as order_count, ifnull(o.order_amount, 0) as order_amount, ifnull(o.shipped_qty, 0) as shipped_qty, ifnull(r.rebate_total, 0) as rebate_total, ifnull(r.redeemed_amount, 0) as redeemed_amount, ifnull(r.offset_amount, 0) as offset_amount, ifnull(r.unsettled_amount, 0) as unsettled_rebate, ifnull(a.receivable_amount, 0) as receivable_amount, ifnull(a.overdue_amount, 0) as overdue_amount, ifnull(a.worst_aging_days, 0) as worst_aging_days, ifnull(f.flow_count, 0) as flow_count, ifnull(f.flow_qty, 0) as flow_qty, ifnull(f.downstream_count, 0) as downstream_count from mk_dealer_profile p inner join mk_customer c on p.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select customer_id, count(*) as order_count, sum(order_amount) as order_amount, sum(ifnull(shipped_qty, 0)) as shipped_qty from mk_order where del_flag = '0' and order_status in ('2', '3', '4') and create_time >= #{params.beginTime} and create_time < date_add(#{params.endTime}, interval 1 day) group by customer_id ) o on o.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select customer_id, sum(rebate_amount) as rebate_total, sum(case when status = '1' then rebate_amount else 0 end) as redeemed_amount, sum(ifnull(offset_amount, 0)) as offset_amount, sum(case when offset_status in ('0', '1') then rebate_amount - ifnull(offset_amount, 0) else 0 end) as unsettled_amount from mk_rebate_settle where del_flag = '0' group by customer_id ) r on r.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select customer_id, sum(plan_amount - ifnull(actual_amount, 0)) as receivable_amount, sum(case when plan_date < curdate() then plan_amount - ifnull(actual_amount, 0) else 0 end) as overdue_amount, max(case when plan_amount - ifnull(actual_amount, 0) > 0 and plan_date < curdate() then datediff(curdate(), plan_date) else 0 end) as worst_aging_days from mk_payment_plan where plan_amount > ifnull(actual_amount, 0) group by customer_id ) a on a.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select dealer_id, count(*) as flow_count, sum(quantity) as flow_qty, count(distinct downstream_name) as downstream_count from mk_dealer_sell_flow where 1 = 1 and flow_date >= #{params.beginTime} and flow_date <= #{params.endTime} group by dealer_id ) f on f.dealer_id = c.customer_id
and c.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and c.customer_no like concat('%', #{customerNo}, '%') and p.dealer_level = #{dealerLevel} and p.auth_regions like concat('%', #{authRegions}, '%') and c.credit_status = #{creditStatus} and p.status = #{status}
mapper.select: order by order_amount desc, c.customer_id desc

) t

select count(*) as allCount, ifnull(sum(p.dealer_level = '1'), 0) as level1Count, ifnull(sum(p.dealer_level = '2'), 0) as level2Count, ifnull(sum(c.credit_status = '1'), 0) as frozenCount from mk_dealer_profile p inner join mk_customer c on p.customer_id = c.customer_id
